Container.Name: architecturer
Container.Overview: Architecturer: AI-first 3D architecture modeler as a remote MCP server. AI apps (Claude web/desktop/mobile, ChatGPT, LM Studio, Claude Code) design buildings from JSON plans, render them and export textured GLB models. Built-in login (accounts, optional two-factor codes), OAuth for AI apps, personal tokens, a live 3D viewer per project and download links.[br][br] First start: open the WebUI; it asks for the setup code printed in this container's log, then you create your account. Locked out? Console: node bin/arch.js user passwd --name YOU (or reset-2fa).[br][br] Internet access: put an HTTPS tunnel or reverse proxy in front (e.g. a Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname -> http://[UNRAID-IP]:5178) and set Public URL to that address. No Cloudflare Access needed; leave bot challenges off for this hostname so Claude and ChatGPT can reach it.[br][br] Memory: a big furnished plan can need ~3.5 GB per render worker while exporting (the template limits the container to 4 GB with 1 worker). No GPU needed.
Container.Requires: For use from Claude / ChatGPT: an HTTPS public hostname (Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy) pointing at this container.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port (MCP endpoint /mcp, admin page /admin, viewer /view). Point the Cloudflare Tunnel's public hostname here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Projects (plans/, exports in plans/exports), auth state (state/: keep private, back it up) and the asset download cache (cache/).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public https origin clients reach (your tunnel hostname), with no path. OAuth and every link use it.

Config.Name: Render workers
Config.Description: Parallel render/export workers. Each can need ~3.5 GB on big plans: raise --memory in Extra Parameters with it (2 workers: --memory=8g).

Config.Name: Allow private network fetches
Config.Description: Set to 1 to let plans load models / textures from LAN addresses (a NAS). Off by default.

Config.Name: Extra allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated extra host names accepted (e.g. tower.local). The public host, localhost and IP addresses are always accepted.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: GPU for the path-traced renders (needs the Nvidia Driver plugin): all, or a GPU UUID from the plugin's page. Without an NVIDIA card remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters; renders then use the CPU rasteriser.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Must include graphics: that is what mounts the Vulkan driver the renderer uses (all is simplest).

Config.Name: Renderer
Config.Description: auto: GPU path tracer when a GPU is visible, else the CPU rasteriser; gpu: GPU only (fail otherwise); cpu: always the rasteriser.

Config.Name: Viewer texture size
Config.Description: Texture resolution of the model the live viewer loads.
